messages:
andrea: quick check — i'm about to change the orders-chart so values.secretName takes precedence over env var fallbacks. goal is to stop creating empty secrets during canary deploys. anyone see an obvious gotcha?

sam: can you paste the template you plan to use? curious how you're guarding for empty strings vs nil

andrea: sure — thinking of:```yaml
# templates/deployment.yaml
env:
  - name: ORDERS_DB_SECRET
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: {{ default .Values.secretName .Values.env.secretName | quote }}
        key: db-uri
```

sam: hmm two notes — default will replace nil but not empty string. if .Values.env.secretName is set to "" it will render empty and k8s will reject the ref. maybe use `ternary` or an `if` guard

maria: yep, I usually do:```gotpl
{{- $s := or .Values.secretName .Values.env.secretName }}
{{- if $s }}
  name: {{ $s }}
{{- else }}
  # no secret provided
{{- end }}
```

andrea: oh nice. the `or` trick covers empty? I thought `or` treats empty string as a value too?

ryan: `or` treats empty string as non-empty, so it won't help if someone passes "". you can use `trim` + `ne` check:```gotpl
{{- $s := trim (or .Values.secretName .Values.env.secretName) "\n\t " }}
{{- if ne $s "" }}
  name: {{ $s | quote }}
{{- end }}```

sam: also consider using an explicit boolean flag like `enableSecretRef` in values so chart behavior is deterministic during chart installs and upgrades — avoids ambiguity between intentionally empty and unset

andrea: good call. for backwards compat i'm thinking default enableSecretRef to true only if either secretName is set non-empty. but configs that set env.secretName: "" should effectively disable it

infra-bot: deploy-check: linting helm/chart/orders-chart against v3.8.0... found: templates/deployment.yaml: secretKeyRef name rendered as empty string in 2/5 test combos

maria: see infra-bot — tests confirm. andrea maybe add an explicit guard + doc note in values.yaml about empty string semantics

andrea: will do. patch plan: 1) add helper in _helpers.tpl to normalize secret name (trim + fallback) 2) add enableSecretRef boolean that defaults to false and is set by umbrella using condition 3) update README values example + add unit test in circleci helm lint matrix

sam: ping me on the PR for quick review, will focus on templates and upgrade behavior

andrea: thanks — i'll open PR in ~30m: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/472 (WIP) :eyes:

ryan: if you can, include a migration note for customers that used the old empty-string pattern — maybe a small postinstall job to annotate resources

andrea: noted. thanks all :rocket:
